title: Public Opinion: BSA Regional Comparison
dashboard_note: Microdata-built weighted distributions from British Social Attitudes only. England, Scotland, and Wales are filtered from the same BSA survey files by Government Office Region, making this the cleaner harmonised regional comparison. Scotland and Wales sample sizes are smaller than the dedicated SSA depth layer, so module-level estimates should be read with their unweighted bases visible.
note: BSA-only regional extraction for England, Scotland, and Wales. This is the harmonised comparison layer; use the BSA-vs-SSA extraction separately as a Scotland depth check.
